title: Brideshead Revisited
author: Evelyn Waugh
summary: Charles Ryder looks back on his friendship with Sebastian Flyte at Oxford and his long entanglement with Sebastian's wealthy, devoutly Catholic family and their house, Brideshead.
readIf: you like elegiac novels about class, faith and faded glamour.
skipIf: you lack patience for a slow, reflective narrator and religious themes.
